scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke-agent.mjs && node daemon/search.test.js && node daemon/fsutil.test.js && node daemon/outline.test.js
scripts.test: npm run smoke && npm run test:agent
scripts.image:mock: cd spark-image && ABLITERATED_IMAGE_MOCK=1 ABLITERATED_IMAGE_HOST=127.0.0.1 ABLITERATED_IMAGE_PORT=7860 python3 serve-openai-bridge.py
scripts.bridge:install: cp scripts/ai.abliteration.bridge.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.abliteration.bridge.plist || launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ai.abliteration.bridge.plist
scripts.bridge:status: launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/ai.abliteration.bridge | head -30; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:17322/
